name: medicare_clinical_features
description: Expanded 163-feature clinical schema (154 symptoms + 9 vitals) for multi-disease inference and Tier 2 Knowledge Base matching.

dyspnea.description: Shortness of Breath / Breathing Difficulty / Wheezing

chest_pain.description: Chest Pain / Tightness / Angina / Pressure in Chest

photophobia.description: Light Sensitivity / Pain in Bright Light

body_aches.description: Myalgia / Muscle Pain / Body Aches / Joint Pain

sex.description: Patient Biological Sex (1.0 = Male, 0.0 = Female, 0.5 = Other/Neutral)

abdominal_pain.description: Abdominal pain or stomach ache / cramps

jaundice.description: Jaundice / Yellowing of skin or sclera

hematemesis.description: Hematemesis / Vomiting blood or coffee-ground emesis

melena.description: Melena / Black tarry stools indicative of upper GI bleeding

hematochezia.description: Hematochezia / Fresh red blood in stool

constipation.description: Constipation / Infrequent or hard bowel movements

tenesmus.description: Tenesmus / Painful spasm with urgent desire to evacuate

palpitations.description: Palpitations / Awareness of rapid, racing, or irregular heartbeat

leg_swelling.description: Peripheral edema / Bilateral or unilateral lower extremity leg swelling

hemoptysis.description: Hemoptysis / Coughing up blood or blood-tinged sputum

paroxysmal_nocturnal_dyspnea.description: Paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea waking patient from sleep

syncope.description: Syncope / Sudden transient loss of consciousness

presyncope.description: Presyncope / Lightheadedness with sensation of impending faint

claudication.description: Intermittent claudication / Cramping leg pain with ambulation

cyanosis.description: Cyanosis / Bluish discoloration of lips, skin, or nail beds

stridor.description: Stridor / Harsh high-pitched inspiratory sound from upper airway obstruction

pleuritic_chest_pain.description: Pleuritic chest pain worsening on deep inspiration

purulent_sputum.description: Purulent yellow/green sputum indicative of bacterial infection

chest_tightness.description: Chest tightness / Sensation of constriction across thorax

snoring.description: Habitual loud snoring or nocturnal gasping

tremor.description: Involuntary rhythmic muscle contraction leading to shaking / tremor

numbness.description: Numbness / Loss of sensation or hypoesthesia

tingling.description: Tingling / Paresthesia / Pins and needles sensation

seizures.description: Seizures / Convulsions / Paroxysmal electrical brain episodes

ataxia.description: Ataxia / Lack of voluntary coordination of muscle movements

facial_droop.description: Facial droop / Asymmetry / Bell palsy presentation

dysarthria.description: Dysarthria / Slurred or impaired motor speech production

aphasia.description: Aphasia / Expressive or receptive language impairment

focal_weakness.description: Focal motor weakness in specific limb or body region

altered_mental_status.description: Altered mental status or fluctuating consciousness

phonophobia.description: Phonophobia / Extreme sensitivity to environmental sounds

visual_aura.description: Visual aura / Scintillating scotoma or geometric light patterns

tinnitus.description: Tinnitus / Ringing, buzzing, or hissing in ears

gait_unsteadiness.description: Gait unsteadiness / Balance impairment while walking

sciatica.description: Sciatica / Radiating neuropathic pain along sciatic nerve

flank_pain.description: Flank pain / Costovertebral angle tenderness / Kidney pain

hematuria.description: Hematuria / Gross or microscopic blood in urine

dysuria.description: Dysuria / Burning or pain during micturition

oliguria.description: Oliguria / Decreased urine output under 400 mL/day

urinary_urgency.description: Urinary urgency / Sudden compelling urge to urinate

nocturia.description: Nocturia / Waking multiple times at night to urinate

urinary_incontinence.description: Urinary incontinence / Involuntary loss of urine

urinary_hesitancy.description: Urinary hesitancy / Difficulty initiating urine stream

urinary_frequency.description: Urinary frequency / Need to urinate abnormally frequently

frothy_urine.description: Frothy or foamy urine indicative of proteinuria

anuria.description: Anuria / Complete absence of urine output (<100 mL/day)

skin_rash.description: Cutaneous eruption / Generalized or localized skin rash

itching.description: Pruritus / Generalized or localized severe skin itching

butterfly_rash.description: Malar butterfly rash over cheeks and bridge of nose (SLE hallmark)

hives.description: Urticaria / Raised erythematous pruritic wheals / hives

joint_swelling.description: Joint swelling / Effusion / Inflammation of synovium

hair_loss.description: Alopecia / Accelerated diffuse or patchy scalp hair loss

purpura.description: Purpura / Non-blanching red or purple petechial skin hemorrhages

petechiae.description: Petechiae / Pinpoint round non-blanching spots on skin or mucosa

erythema.description: Cutaneous erythema / Abnormal redness of skin

joint_pain.description: Arthralgia / Pain within joints without gross effusion

morning_stiffness.description: Morning joint stiffness lasting greater than 30 minutes

skin_peeling.description: Desquamation / Peeling or scaling of epidermal skin

ulcers_oral.description: Aphthous or painful ulcers in oral mucosal cavity

photosensitivity.description: Photosensitivity / Exaggerated skin response to sunlight

raynaud_phenomenon.description: Raynaud phenomenon / Triphasic color changes of fingers in cold

dry_eyes.description: Keratoconjunctivitis sicca / Severe dry grittiness in eyes

dry_mouth.description: Xerostomia / Severe dryness of oral mucous membranes

skin_thickening.description: Sclerodactyly / Induration and thickening of dermis

nail_clubbing.description: Digital nail clubbing / Increased angle between nail bed and fold

easy_bruising.description: Ecchymosis / Excessive bruising following minor trauma

rigors.description: Rigors / Shaking chills with profound teeth chattering

night_sweats.description: Drenching nocturnal diaphoresis requiring clothing change

malaise.description: Malaise / Generalized sensation of profound bodily discomfort

weight_gain.description: Rapid unexplained weight gain or fluid retention

cachexia.description: Cachexia / Severe muscle wasting and profound debility

insomnia.description: Insomnia / Inability to initiate or maintain sleep

heat_intolerance.description: Heat intolerance / Inability to tolerate warm environments

cold_intolerance.description: Cold intolerance / Inability to tolerate cool environments

generalized_weakness.description: Asthenia / Generalized loss of muscular strength

myalgia.description: Myalgia / Diffuse muscle soreness or tenderness

arthralgia.description: Arthralgia / Joint aches across multiple articulations

goiter.description: Goiter / Visibly enlarged or palpable thyroid gland in neck

hypoglycemia_symptoms.description: Shakiness, sweating, diaphoresis, and anxiety relieved by glucose

galactorrhea.description: Inappropriate breast milk secretion without lactation

gynecomastia.description: Gynecomastia / Palpable enlargement of male glandular breast tissue

hirsutism.description: Hirsutism / Male-pattern coarse terminal hair growth in females

pallor.description: Cutaneous or conjunctival pallor indicative of severe anemia

bleeding_gums.description: Gingival bleeding / Spontaneous bleeding from gums

menorrhagia.description: Menorrhagia / Abnormally heavy or prolonged menstrual bleeding

bone_pain.description: Deep persistent bone pain, notably in axial skeleton or long bones

muscle_cramps.description: Painful involuntary muscle cramps or tetany

flushing.description: Cutaneous episodic flushing of face, neck, and upper chest

eye_pain.description: Ocular pain / Deep ache or sharp pain within globe

vision_loss.description: Partial or total sudden or progressive loss of vision

ear_discharge.description: Otorrhea / Purulent or serous discharge from ear canal

sore_tongue.description: Glossitis / Pain, burning, or redness of tongue surface

loss_of_taste.description: Ageusia / Diminished or absent taste sensation

loss_of_smell.description: Anosmia / Diminished or absent olfactory sensation

foreign_body_sensation.description: Sensation of foreign particle in eye or throat

epiphora.description: Epiphora / Excessive tearing or watering of eyes
